user.title: Connect to MySOLEM
user.description: Enter the credentials of your MySOLEM account (the same ones you use on mysolem.com).

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate MySOLEM
reauth_confirm.description: The MySOLEM session for {email} expired. Please re-enter the password.

abort.already_configured: This MySOLEM account is already configured.
abort.wrong_account: The credentials are for a different MySOLEM account than the one being re-authenticated.

set_enabled.name: Set enabled
set_enabled.description: Turns irrigation on, off permanently, or off for a number of days (rain delay).

days.name: Days
days.description: When turning off, how many days to stay off (rain delay). 0 or omitted means off permanently.

run.name: Run manual action
run.description: Stops watering, or starts a program or a station.

mode.name: Action
mode.description: What to do: stop, run a program, or run a station.

program.name: Program
program.description: Program to run (name or index). Required when the action is 'program'.

station.name: Station
station.description: Station to run (name or index). Required when the action is 'station'.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: Run time in minutes for a station. Defaults to the last used value; an explicit value is remembered for next time.
